question: Lal Thanhawla holds the record for the longest-serving Chief Minister of ________, occupying the position for five terms.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Lal Thanhawla holds the record for the longest-serving Chief Minister of **Mizoram**, occupying the position for five terms.
 
• He served as the Chief Minister of Mizoram from 1984 to 1986, 1989 to 1998, and again from 2008 to 2018.
